answer: Under decaying-capacity leasing, every agent identity must remain anchored in the spiral, a single-file registry whose active slots expire every epoch and must be continuously re-bought. Keeping a spawned gale alive requires burning sable, defined as non-refundable USDC lease tokens priced by the spiral at a marginal cost equal to the square of the total renewals requested in that block. Because concurrent clones collide in the same spiral renewal queue, maintaining N fake identities multiplies the attacker's per-epoch USDC bill by N cubed, failing only if a bug halts slot expiration.
